text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin isn't feeling well, so I take<n>her to the
infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're such a worrier. But fine.<n>I won't
budge from this bed until I'm<n>all rested up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
Agent Ines has successfully<n>infiltrated the
compound. Sounds like<n>her mic's functioning just
fine too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wuh, what?! "Infiltrated?" What's<n>this all about?

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
Quiet. You were the one who applied<n>to be a
part-time spy, remember?

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. Make your way to the top<n>floor and
retrieve the evidence while<n>remaining undetected.
The fate of the<n>world rests in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! Hmm... I think I remember<n>applying for
this role a while back?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I signed up for this, so I'd better<n>do a good
job!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By "evidence," did they mean this<n>pearl? I mean,
it's literally tagged,<n>"The Evidence."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to stash this and make my<n>escape—

text_block_list.name: Evil Inc. Security Guard A
text_block_list.text:
Who goes there?! Intruder spotted on<n>the seventh
floor! Send backup!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! This is bad! I'd better get out<n>of here fast!

text_block_list.name: Evil Inc. Security Guard B
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Tch! This one sure knowshow to duck and dive!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but when it comes to making<n>an escape,
there's no way I'm<n>losing!

text_block_list.name: Commander
text_block_list.text:
Good job, Agent Ines! The world is<n>safe now,
thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yay! I saved... the Earth... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, geez. It was all a dream! It's<n>probably
'cause of that cartoon I<n>watched with my sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I slept well, and I kept the world safe<n>from harm
too. Everything worked out<n>nicely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! They've got me surrounded!<n>This means...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've failed my task!
Ines Fujin remains worn out after her<n>nightmare.
